frequency_question: How often do central banking administrative and technical notification workflows for liquidity measures complete within a 42-day window from inception to public circular release?
membership_rule: Includes all formal central bank circulars or notifications regarding incremental reserve requirements or specialized liquidity measures issued within a 30 to 45 day operational window. Excludes standard bi-weekly monetary policy committee rate announcements.

cases.name: RBI Variable Reverse Repo (VRRR) Main Operations Introduction

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; complete set of targeted sudden liquidity absorption ratio mandates in the decade.
known_gaps: Emergency interventions during systemic liquidity shocks often bypass standard multi-week consultative tracks, compressing the timeline further.
skeleton: Regulatory drafting (3 days) + internal executive committee approval (2 days) + IT system parameterization testing (10 days) + official gazette/circular publication window (2 days). Total operational path: 17 business days.
multiplier: 17 business days required out of 30 available calendar days in a standard operational sprint.
validity_reason: Core central bank digital clearing and notification infrastructure remains stable across multi-year intervals.
